note: Structured record of a dependency advisory and this project's mitigation. It is an operator record, not an upstream authority: the linked advisory and the upstream repository remain the sources of truth.

advisories.exposure: Build-time only. The deployed architecture is asset-only static output with no shared cache, so the advisory's cross-user cache-disclosure path is not reachable in production.
advisories.interpretation: Upstream 4.3.0 sits outside the advisory's affected range but is not a verified fix. The advisory still lists no patched version, the upstream maintainer disputes the premise, and controlled probes against the unmodified 4.3.0 tarball continued to accept restricted max-stale reuse. The locked conservative patch therefore remains required and the dependency is not upgraded on the strength of a version number alone.

reassessment_log.conclusion: The unmodified upstream release still accepts every restricted stale-reuse path and the advisory still lists no patched version, so the local patch remains required. Protection preserved; the 2026-11-03 deadline is unchanged and is not yet due.
reassessment_log.date_convention: Dates are recorded in UTC. The readiness gate compares a date-only field against the assessment instant in UTC, so a local calendar date can read as a future date and fail the check.

advisories.next_action: Re-run the five restricted max-stale probes against the current upstream release and the advisory text before 2026-11-03. Remove the patch only when the unmodified upstream release rejects every probe, or when Astro removes the dependency.
